digest.component_or_area: test subprocess environment isolation and credential safety
propositions: 103 test subprocess environment constructions using dict(os.environ) or {**os.environ} leak inherited credential values in pytest long tracebacks when process startup fails
A mutable dict subclass with redacted __repr__ preserves exact subprocess semantics and child environment values while preventing credential disclosure in exception rendering
An AST repository-policy guard must reject both raw broad environment constructors and boundary unwrapping patterns (dict(boundary) and {**boundary})
The fix routes all 103 non-fixture constructions through a representation-safe environment mapping that preserves keys, values, order, and intentional ambient propagation
Nested pytest startup-failure oracle and short/long traceback controls confirm zero sentinel/credential disclosures in default-long output while child processes receive exact inherited values
Seven separately-owned decorated fixtures are excluded structurally; lint, typecheck, and full test suite (14,019 passed) confirm no test weakening or production path changes
